title: 第28章 惊动执事
content_zh:
张山回来，留下一封信？

    韩榆听着这话，目不斜视。

    心中暗想，李老道这样干倒是能够尽快脱去他自己的嫌疑，的确也不失为一个办法。

    “张山师兄就这么一走了之，我往后修炼可怎么办？”

    刘兰擦了擦眼泪说道：“本来说好的……”

    她这话，没有人回应。

    谁能接替张山，把自己的修炼资源给她？

    正说话之间，一声叫嚣远远传来：“凑在一起做什么！”

    众人转头望去，王管事挺着肥肚子走过来。

    李老道身体顿时绷紧，将敛息术运转到极致，并将头顶斗笠顺手压了一下。

    韩榆也立刻运转敛息术——不怕一万就怕万一，王管事万一能察觉他的修为或者炼血功的迹象呢？

    他们两人显然想多了，王管事大大咧咧走过来，韦坤仪便露出柔媚笑容走上前去：“王管事，您早啊！”

    王管事嘿嘿一笑：“你也早！”

    又板起脸来：“你们在这里聚在一起闹什么呢？”

    韦坤仪从刘兰手中拽出黄纸，递给王管事：“王管事，您瞧，杂役弟子张山留下这么一张纸，说突破练气四层无望，自己外出闯荡去了，归期不定。”

    王管事把脸一沉，接过黄纸：“归期不定？好一个归期不定！”

    “想走就走，想来就来，把我这灵田处当他家床榻了吗？”

    “这分明是携带宗门功法是指潜逃，要交给外门弟子追上带回，并且给与处罚的！”

    叫嚷这两句之后，又问道：“这张山，你们谁了解？”

    韦坤仪顿时笑着说：“王管事，我知道。”

    “张山是五灵根，入门已经有二十年，七年前突破到练气三层后，一直没有突破。”

    “想来是因此感觉此生无望进外门，这才决定外出。”
content_en:
Zhang Shan came back and left a letter?

Han Yu listened to this without squinting.

He secretly thought that Li Laodao could get rid of his own suspicion as soon as possible by doing this, and it was indeed a way.

"Senior Brother Zhang Shan just left like this, what will I do if I continue to practice?"

Liu Lan wiped her tears and said, "It was originally agreed..."

No one responded to her words.

Who can replace Zhang Shan and give her his own cultivation resources?

While they were talking, a shout came from a distance: "What are we doing together!"

Everyone turned to look and saw Manager Wang walking over with a fat belly.

Li Laodao's body immediately tensed up, he used his breathing technique to the extreme, and pressed the bamboo hat on his head.

Han Yu also immediately used the breath-condensing technique - don't be afraid of ten thousand, just be afraid of what might happen. What if Manager Wang could detect signs of his cultivation or blood refining skills?

The two of them were obviously overthinking it. Manager Wang came over carelessly, and Wei Kunyi stepped forward with a sweet smile: "Good morning, Manager Wang!"

Manager Wang chuckled: "It's early for you too!"

Then he said with a serious face: "What are you guys doing together here?"

Wei Kunyi pulled out the yellow paper from Liu Lan's hand and handed it to Manager Wang: "Manager Wang, look, the handyman disciple Zhang Shan left this piece of paper, saying that there was no hope of breaking through the fourth level of Qi training, and he went out on his own, and his return date is uncertain."

Manager Wang's face sank, and he took the yellow paper: "The return date is uncertain? What an uncertain return date!"

"You can leave when you want, come when you want, do you think of my spiritual field as his bed?"

"This clearly means that you are absconding with the sect's martial arts, and you have to leave it to the outer disciples to catch up and bring you back and punish you!"

After shouting these two sentences, he asked again: "Which of you understands this mountain?"

Wei Kunyi immediately smiled and said, "Manager Wang, I know."

"Zhang Shan has five spiritual roots. He has been practicing for twenty years. He has not broken through since he broke through to the third level of Qi training seven years ago."

"I think it was because I felt that there was no hope of entering the outer gate in this life, so I decided to go out."
